dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: This gallery is amazing, Nam. Where should we start?
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈɡæləri ɪz əˈmeɪzɪŋ, ˈnɑːm. ˈwɛr ʃʊd wiː ˈstɑːrt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let's start with the paintings on this floor.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈstɑːrt wɪð ðə ˈpeɪntɪŋz ɑːn ðɪs ˈflɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Look at this one. It's a beautiful old Japanese painting of a mountain.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk ət ðɪs ˈwʌn. ɪts ə ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈoʊld ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˈpeɪntɪŋ əv ə ˈmaʊntən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's a landscape. I love the soft colors.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ə ˈlændskeɪp. aɪ ˈlʌv ðə ˈsɔːft ˈkʌlərz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And what about this portrait? A serious young Thai woman in a long red silk dress.
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ðɪs ˈpɔːrtrət? ə ˈsɪriəs ˈjʌŋ ˈtaɪ ˈwʊmən ɪn ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈrɛd ˈsɪlk ˈdrɛs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She looks a bit sad, doesn't she?
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈlʊks ə ˈbɪt ˈsæd, ˈdʌzənt ʃiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A famous Thai artist. The painting is more than seventy years old.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈfeɪməs ˈtaɪ ˈɑːrtɪst. ðə ˈpeɪntɪŋ ɪz ˈmɔːr ðən ˈsɛvənti ˈjɪrz ˈoʊld.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Wow. And there's a huge modern sculpture in the next room.
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ. ənd ðɛrz ə ˈhjuːdʒ ˈmɑːdərn ˈskʌlptʃər ɪn ðə ˈnɛkst ˈruːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A huge modern sculpture? Let's go and see it!
dialogue.reading: ə ˈhjuːdʒ ˈmɑːdərn ˈskʌlptʃər? ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ ənd ˈsiː ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Wait. Let's take a photo of this lovely little blue Chinese bowl first.
dialogue.reading: ˈweɪt. ˈlɛts ˈteɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðɪs ˈlʌvli ˈlɪtəl ˈbluː ˌtʃaɪˈniːz ˈboʊl ˈfɜːrst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK, but let's hurry. The gallery closes at six!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, bʌt ˈlɛts ˈhɜːri. ðə ˈɡæləri ˈkloʊzɪz ət ˈsɪks!
